title: Arguments of `board.update` (a new revision of a panel)
description: The `authz.object.args` of a live `board.update` action: the panel's whole new title and content. `revision` is the new revision; the node refuses one that is not newer than what it holds (`stale_revision`). The panel's kind does not change.

content.description: At most 32,000 bytes of UTF-8. JSON Schema counts characters, so core and the node also count bytes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `content`'s UTF-8 bytes, lower-case hex.

cost_paise.description: What making this panel cost, in paise (0 when the cost is carried by another panel of the same job).
